question: Joint reward, switching-friction, continuation-coefficient and capacity-budget misspecification, distinct from covariate shift.

validation.context_law: R16 contexts: six reward integers uniform -16..16 and friction integer 2..32, independent
validation.models: The same eight pre-R22 frozen tanh-gradient and eight RBF-direct models; deterministic mean prediction; no new training
validation.workspace: Fresh QP workspace for every solve, no inter-query or inter-policy state
validation.exact_audit: All recorded implemented decisions and vertex comparator upper bounds replayed in stdlib integer/Fraction arithmetic
validation.failure_policy: Record all solve failures, substitute zero proposal with valid zero-dual comparator upper when needed; retain negative certificates
validation.no_statistical_overreach: Pointwise robust guarantees and paired descriptive summaries only. No training-randomness claim, no field calibration, no new positive population-gain claim.

comparator: At every hidden model the true reoptimized accepted time-only amendment. Each vertex upper bound optimizes a declared common outer class containing the union of these model-specific restricted classes.
repair: Rational equality-preserving root reconstruction and minimal mixture with a strictly robust feasible anchor; no numerical tolerance for feasibility
cost_scope: Descriptive solve/repair/audit work on current host; not a matched-runtime acceleration claim. Robust certification adds eight outer-comparator solves per observed context/radius.
